verdict.rationale: Speechmatics has a dedicated languages documentation page (speech-to-text/languages.md). It covers language identification and a bilingual Arabic–English option, and the pricing page cites a count of 56 languages for its auto-language model. However, the evidence never shows the actual enumerated list or a per-model/per-feature support matrix. Missing for 10: the concrete published language list itself, explicit per-model and per-feature (realtime vs batch, translation, domain models) language differences, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the supported languages are published as a concrete list, with any per-model or per-feature differences stated

citations.quote: Transcribes 56 languages without choosing one up front, switches language mid-sentence.
Ideal when transcribing Arabic and English in the same media file or stream.
To automatically identify the language in an audio file, use the Language Identification feature.
